conv.title: Little Italy Loft

bubbles.text: Hi John! Checking in for our upcoming arrival at Little Italy Loft from Sun, Jul 12. Is there anything we should know before we get there?

Hi Yasmin — all set for you. Everything you need is below.

PARKING:
Two cars fit in the driveway. There is also street parking if needed. A level 2 EV charger is available in the carport as needed.

ENTRY CODE:
- Press the keypad symbol
- Enter 2656 and press the tick
- When you leave, pull the door tight and press the symbol to lock — no code needed
- Please adjust the HVAC when leaving to conserve energy

BED SETUP:
The primary bedroom will be set up as a King unless you prefer 2 Twin XLs. Please let us know.

WIFI:
Network: LittleItalyLoft
Password: welcome42

GUIDEBOOK + HOUSE MANUAL:
Open the house manual

WELCOME:
The home has been cleaned and stocked in preparation for your arrival. If you have any issues with the cleanliness, please let us know right away. If you have any questions, issues or concerns during your stay please reach out. If something is off, we want the chance to make it right.

Enjoy! If you have any other questions, just let me know.

Best,
Heather
San Diego, CA Vacation Rentals
